summaryZh: 本文报道了农业机械改装自动驾驶套件领域的最新进展，指出该领域已从单纯的转向辅助升级为集传感器、云连接和实时规划监控软件于一体的完整自动驾驶平台。文章重点介绍了AgXeed VCU等新产品，并提及《Future Farming》改装套件目录的更新，反映了行业正通过软件集成和资源整合加速商业化落地，对缓解农业劳动力短缺具有现实意义。
featuredReason: 本文揭示了农机自动驾驶从硬件改装向软件平台化发展的关键趋势，其传感器融合与云端规划思路对智慧畜牧中的无人化作业管理具有直接借鉴价值。

Retrofit autonomy grows up: Planning software, sensor fusion and consolidation reshape the sector

Behind the VCU sits TraXwise, AgXeed’s own planning and monitoring platform, which lets a farmer or manager plan an entire working route in advance. Photo: AgXeed

Autonomous retrofit kits have quietly shifted into a technology category that is reshaping how farms think about labour, machinery investment and field operations. It is turning into something closer to a full autonomy platform, layered with sensors, cloud connectivity, and software that plans, monitors and adjusts field work in real time.
